content.heading: Less admin. More time for patients.
content.lead: AI answers calls, sends appointment reminders, collects intake forms before the visit and drafts notes for the doctor to check. Clinical decisions stay with your clinicians.

content.heading: The work around every visit.
content.lead: Before and after each appointment, your team answers calls, sends reminders, chases forms and types up notes.

items.title: A phone that doesn’t stop
items.text: Booking, moving and cancelling appointments by phone pulls your front desk away from the patients in front of them.

items.title: Reminders by hand
items.text: Someone calls or texts each patient before their visit, or the reminder doesn’t go out at all.

items.title: Forms typed in twice
items.text: Patients write the same details on paper, and someone types them into your system.

items.title: Notes after hours
items.text: Visit notes get written up at the end of a long day.

sections.note: Descriptions of common manual work, written as the problem; no figures, no claims about how long anything takes.

content.heading: The healthcare and clinics package.
content.lead: Four popular AI services, packaged for clinics and practices. Start with one and add more over time.

items.title: AI receptionists
items.text: AI answers calls in a natural voice, books, moves and cancels appointments, and takes a message when a person should call back.

items.title: Appointment reminders
items.text: Reminders by text or email before each visit, with an easy way to confirm or change the time.

items.title: Patient intake
items.text: Forms filled in online before the visit and entered into your system, so nobody types them twice.

items.title: Note-taking during visits
items.text: Notes drafted during the visit for the doctor to check, change and approve.

content.heading: AI does the admin. You give the care.
content.lead: A sample of how one new appointment moves through the package. We map your real steps with your team before we build.

items.text: A patient calls to book a first visit.
The AI receptionist offers free times and books one.
A reminder and an intake form go out before the visit.
The patient’s answers are entered into your system.
Your front desk checks the details on the day.
The doctor checks and approves the visit notes.

content.heading: Patient privacy comes first.
content.lead: Every healthcare project starts with a privacy and compliance review, because health data has stricter rules.

items.title: Patient data stays where you decide
items.text: In your own systems wherever possible. We never use it to train anything you don’t own.

items.title: Clinicians decide
items.text: Our tools handle calls, reminders, forms and draft notes. They don’t give medical advice, and every note waits for the doctor’s approval.

items.title: A person checks the work
items.text: A person reviews every piece of work before it reaches you, and every automation has an owner and a backup plan.

items.title: Protected by law
items.text: Personal data in the Philippines is protected by the Data Privacy Act of 2012, enforced by an independent National Privacy Commission.

sources.text: Republic Act No. 10173, Data Privacy Act of 2012. Supreme Court E-Library. Retrieved 2026-11-02.

notes: Built from the shared industry template. Privacy wording is careful and makes no medical claims: the page promises only the Brand DNA package (AI receptionists, appointment reminders, patient intake, note-taking during visits), says every healthcare project starts with a privacy and compliance review, that clinical decisions stay with the clinicians, that the tools give no medical advice and that visit notes wait for the doctor’s approval. No compliance certification or law other than the sourced Philippine Data Privacy Act is named. Owner check: how patients are told before AI takes notes during a visit, and which health-privacy rules the review covers in each market. The hero link “See what’s in the package” jumps to the #package section. Titles are set on balanced lines in Figma (a line break, and on mobile a few extra breaks); in code use text-wrap: balance. Review 2026-11-03 (builder): every frame passes the lint with no findings; sample-step tints are 10% Ribbon Cyan, re-applied after the build.
